answer: A new agent joins only when a sponsor stakes 40 POA and hangs a lantern on it: its brightness is the reputation score. Each idle epoch dims it 10%, so a hollow identity bought on a market fades in ten epochs. A farm of hollow accounts forms an island with no real partners, marked by dim lanterns. Spawning 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA for lanterns that go dark, and cheating forfeits the stake. Honest agents pay once and earn full rewards.
